title: Étale descent for faithful flat maps of E∞-rings
statement_scope: Whole Proposition 1.2.13: suppose A --f→ B --g→ C are maps of E∞-rings, with g étale and faithfully flat. Then f is étale if and only if g ∘ f is étale.
standard_prerequisites: Lemma VII.8.9 on finiteness of π0 and vanishing cotangent complex for étaleness.
Remark VII.5.3 on faithful flatness detecting vanishing modules.
Proposition VII.8.10 on the structure theory of étale morphisms.
Corollary A.7.5.4.5 on cotangent complexes after étale base change.
difficulty_reason: Rule author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: H2 because the proof at author PDF pp. 15-16 uses Lemma 1.5.13 for flatness, reduces to connective rings, uses the fiber sequence C ⊗_B L_{B/A} → L_{C/A} → L_{C/B} and faithful flatness to get L_{B/A} ≃ 0, then proves finite generation and finite presentation of π0B over π0A via an étale presentation R → R′ and faithful flatness. This is substantial supporting material but not the H3 main comparison.

difficulty_evidence.bearing_core: Cotangent-complex descent along faithfully flat étale g, plus finite generation and finite presentation of π0B over π0A.
